battery.why: re-scoring a deliberately blanked product pool against the 8 gated gate(s) whose own comparator recalls >=1 frozen id(s) fails all of them (['coverage::union_frozen_texts_authority_not_below_baseline::business-judgment-rule', 'coverage::union_frozen_texts_authority_not_below_baseline::corporate-criminal-liability', 'coverage::union_frozen_texts_authority_not_below_baseline::petty-theft-dismissal', 'coverage::union_frozen_texts_counter_not_below_baseline::business-judgment-rule', 'coverage::union_frozen_texts_counter_not_below_baseline::corporate-criminal-liability', 'coverage::union_frozen_texts_counter_not_below_baseline::petty-theft-dismissal', 'coverage::union_frozen_texts_counter_not_below_baseline::rent-default', 'parity::same_query_counter_not_below_baseline::corporate-criminal-liability'])
scoring a family's own comparator rows as the product pool reproduces that family's comparator hits for every measurable gated gate; a failure would mean the gate is defective, not the product

scoring each family's own comparator rows as the product pool yields identical hits, so a product pool that contains only the executed text's rows can never be reported as a same-text falsification; a coverage-only deficit is attributed to the coverage family and never to the same-text family

success_rule: PASS_NO_PARITY_REGRESSION (exit 0) if and only if every MEASURABLE gate of BOTH gated families holds (product_hits >= its comparator_hits) and every non-vacuity control holds. Any measurable gate of either family with product_hits < comparator_hits is FAIL_PRODUCT_CACHE_PARITY (exit 1). Zero measurable gated cells, a pin mismatch, a missing mount, or a failed non-vacuity control is ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS / NOT_MEASURED (exit 2) - never a pass and never a bar-met. The gate family that drove the verdict is published (verdict_scope) together with the two family verdicts (same_text_parity_verdict, coverage_verdict), so a reader can see WHICH comparison failed without having to re-derive it. The absolute product:: recall gates (>=1-of-set) are REPORTED with role=report_only_absolute and are NOT counted as falsifiers: an absolute miss whose same-query plain comparator also misses is not a product-layer defect, and a miss the plain search did not suffer is already caught by the corresponding parity:: gate. Every side publishes hits, misses and yields together.
claim_ceiling: This benchmark can establish TWO things and nothing more: (1) on the frozen query text(s) the product's own cached retrieval actually executed, how many of the frozen controlling-authority ids and frozen known counter-authority ids the PRODUCT's retrieval layer reaches compared with the plain OpenCaseLaw client's response to that same text; and (2) how much of what the plain OpenCaseLaw client reached when it answered ALL the frozen texts (baseline+counter channels x fr/de/it) the product's cached retrieval reaches at all, i.e. the multilingual/counter-channel QUERY-COVERAGE deficit. It does NOT claim that the product's retrieval quality is worse than plain OpenCaseLaw on the text it ran (that is the separately gated same-text family, reported beside the coverage family); it does NOT score any served bundle or packet (it therefore touches no packet-of-record byte and lifts no order); it does NOT re-classify any decision as supporting/contrary/limiting; it does NOT re-score, meet or move the frozen absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars (they stay REPORTED-ONLY); it does NOT lift the accepted DO-NOT-SERVE order on packet 38839347028 nor DO-NOT-SERVE-UNCHANGED on rebuilt-39027045675; it does NOT certify admission of any packet; it does NOT claim the map helps a jurist; it does NOT re-issue the retracted 39111232991 parity claim; it does NOT rebuild or re-dispatch any Frontier component (counter-anchor classifier accept d236f599, relevance_ordered geometry accept be5eba7f/dc3ffc6c and counter-label-emission accept 44d4904b stay closed). human_gate_ready, machine_gate_ready, packet_admitted and ready_for_owner_session all stay false; owner_decision_required stays false. NOT_MEASURED / NOT_APPLICABLE is never a pass.
